passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: You should read the following discussion in conjunction with the audited consolidated financial statements and the corresponding notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report. This Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations contains forward-looking statements. The matters discussed in these forward-looking statements are subject to risk, uncertainties and other factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from those made, projected or implied in the forward-looking statements. Refer to “Risk Factors” and “Forward-Looking Statements” for a discussion of the uncertainties, risks and assumptions associated with these statements. Overview We are a global leader in optical and photonic technologies and an industry-leading provider of optical and photonic products based on revenue and market share. Our products are essential to a range of cloud, artificial intelligence and machine learning (“AI/ML”), telecommunications, consumer, and industrial end-market applications. We believe the global markets in which Lumentum participates have fundamentally robust, long-term trends that will increase the need for our photonics products and technologies. We believe the world is becoming more reliant on ever-increasing amounts of data flowing through optical networks and data centers. Lumentum’s products and technology enable the scaling of these optical networks and data centers to higher capacities. AI/ML has caused a dramatic surge in the growing demands on data networking in cloud data centers and accelerated the usage of optical components and modules. We expect that the accelerating shift to digital and virtual approaches to many aspects of work and life will continue into the future. Virtual meetings, video calls, and hybrid in-person and virtual environments for work and other aspects of life will continue to drive strong needs for bandwidth growth and present dynamic new challenges that our technologies address. As manufacturers demand higher levels of precision, new materials, and factory and energy efficiency, suppliers of manufacturing tools globally are turning to laser-based approaches, including the types of lasers Lumentum supplies. Laser-based 3D sensing and LiDAR for security, industrial and automotive applications are rapidly developing markets. The technology enables computer vision applications that enhance security, safety, and new functionality in the electronic devices that people rely on every day. The use of LiDAR and in-cabin 3D sensing in automobile and delivery vehicles will over time significantly add to our long-term market opportunity. To maintain and grow our market and technology leadership positions, we are continually investing in new and differentiated products and technologies and customer programs that address both nearer-term and longer-term growth opportunities, both organically and through acquisitions, as well as continually improving and optimizing our operations. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the section titled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” and our consolidated financial statements and related notes, before making a decision to invest in our common stock. Our business, financial condition, results of operations or prospects could also be harmed by risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently do not believe are material. If any of the risks actually occur, our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects could be adversely affected. In that event, the market price of our common stock could decline, and you could lose part or all of your investment. credit_strengths.text: Lumentum's revenue and operating income inflected sharply upward, with the company returning to profitability after prior-year losses as AI/ML-driven demand for optical and photonic components accelerated. Operating cash flow expanded materially alongside earnings, evidencing genuine cash conversion rather than accounting-driven improvement, and providing a durable base for internal funding of growth investment.

The balance sheet carries a net cash position once cash and short-term investments are measured against interest-bearing debt, placing leverage well below the sector median on a net basis. Liquidity is ample, with a current ratio modestly below the sector median but comfortably above unity, and interest coverage far exceeds the sector median, indicating substantial capacity to absorb rate or earnings volatility.

key_risks.text: The debt note discloses that substantially all convertible notes are recorded as current liabilities because the stock traded above the conversion threshold, meaning holders may require cash settlement of principal within the coming year. This concentrates refinancing and liquidity risk in the near term and could consume a large share of the disclosed cash balance if conversions are elected rather than refinanced.

Disclosed risk factors include reliance on a limited number of suppliers and customers, order cancellations or delivery delays, supply chain constraints, and higher tariffs and trade restrictions involving China and Thailand. These are concrete earnings-volatility drivers for a communications equipment issuer whose revenue is concentrated in cloud and AI/ML end markets, and they could pressure margins and cash flow if realized.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is exceptionally strong relative to the sector median, and free cash flow covers a meaningful portion of debt, though the ratio sits below the sector median because the debt base remains sizable. Capital expenditure absorbs a large share of operating cash flow, so discretionary cash generation, while positive, is thinner than headline operating cash flow suggests.

Gross leverage is modest and net leverage is negative on a cash-only basis, with the broader net-debt measure also indicating a net cash position. This provides headroom against the sector median leverage, but the convertible maturity wall means servicing capacity depends on refinancing access or equity-linked conversion outcomes rather than on cash flow alone.

overall_credit_view.text: Lumentum presents a strengthening credit profile: revenue and operating income recovered strongly, operating cash flow is robust, and the company holds net cash against reported debt. The indicative financial risk profile is minimal, and leverage sits below the sector median. Our forward view is that credit quality should remain sound provided AI/ML-driven demand persists and the convertible notes are managed without straining liquidity.

The principal watch items are the near-term convertible maturity concentration, customer and supplier concentration, and trade-policy exposure. Capital expenditure intensity limits free cash flow relative to the sector, and the Altman Z double-prime zone flags distress on a statistical basis, which we treat as a caution rather than a rating. Continued earnings delivery and orderly liability management are the key credit drivers.

credit_strengths.text: Lumentum 的收入及經營溢利急劇向上轉折，公司在過往年度虧損後恢復盈利，因 AI/ML 驅動對光學及光子元件的需求加速。經營現金流隨盈利大幅擴張，證明是真正的現金轉換而非會計驅動的改善，並為增長投資的內部資金提供持久基礎。
以現金及短期投資對比計息債務衡量，資產負債表呈淨現金狀況，使槓桿按淨額基準遠低於行業中位數。流動性充裕，流動比率略低於行業中位數但穩居於一以上，而利息覆蓋率遠超行業中位數，顯示有雄厚能力吸收利率或盈利波動。

key_risks.text: 債務票據披露，絕大部分可換股票據入賬為流動負債，因股價高於轉換門檻，意味持有人可能要求在未來一年內以現金結算本金。這使再融資及流動性風險集中於短期，若選擇轉換而非再融資，可能消耗已披露現金結餘的一大部分。
已披露風險因素包括依賴有限數目供應商及客戶、訂單取消或交付延遲、供應鏈限制，以及涉及中國及泰國的較高關稅及貿易限制。對於收入集中於雲端及 AI/ML 終端市場的通訊設備發行人而言，這些是具體的盈利波動驅動因素，若成真可能對利潤率及現金流構成壓力。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率相對行業中位數異常強勁，自由現金流覆蓋債務的相當部分，惟比率低於行業中位數，因債務基數仍然龐大。資本開支吸收經營現金流的一大部分，故可自由支配的現金產生雖為正數，但較標題經營現金流所示為薄。
總槓桿溫和，按僅計現金基準淨槓桿為負，而更廣泛的淨債務衡量亦顯示淨現金狀況。這相對行業中位數槓桿提供緩衝，但可換股到期牆意味償債能力取決於再融資渠道或股權掛鈎轉換結果，而非僅依賴現金流。

overall_credit_view.text: Lumentum 呈現增強的信用狀況：收入及經營溢利強勁復甦，經營現金流穩健，公司相對報告債務持有淨現金。指示性財務風險狀況為極低，槓桿低於行業中位數。我們的前瞻觀點是，只要 AI/ML 驅動的需求持續，且可換股票據在不會令流動性受壓的情況下管理，信用質素應保持穩健。
主要觀察事項為短期可換股到期集中、客戶及供應商集中，以及貿易政策敞口。資本開支強度限制自由現金流相對行業的水平，而 Altman Z 雙重prime 區域在統計基礎上標示困境，我們視之為警示而非評級。持續的盈利交付及有序的負債管理是關鍵信用驅動因素。
